ai_summary: Advent Hotels International Limited has converted its wholly-owned subsidiary, Advent Convention and Hotels International Private Limited, into a 50:50 joint venture with Prestige Falcon Realty Ventures for a substantial commercial real estate project in Mumbai, valued at approximately Rs. 4,500 Crores GDV. This represents a strategic shift from full control to shared development, involving significant future capital infusion via loans or convertible securities beyond the initial equity. A key red flag is that the project entity, Advent, has reported nil turnover since its incorporation in 2024, indicating a massive undertaking by an unproven venture.
